-- Agent TSR - RSR


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent TSR (4)]
AS Divide([Measures].[Agent TSR (4) Numerator],[Measures].[Total Interactions Handled]),
CAPTION='Agent TSR (4)',FORMAT_STRING = "Percent", VISIBLE = 1 ,DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Agent TSR - RSR';     


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent TSR (5) Numerator]
AS [Measures].[RGU5 Upgrades]+[Measures].[XM RGU Connects]+
+[Measures].[Bulk XI RGU Connects]
+[Measures].[Bulk XTV RGU Connects]
+[Measures].[Bulk XV RGU Connects]
+[Measures].[Bulk XH RGU Connects],
FORMAT_STRING =  "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 0 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Agent TSR - RSR';     


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent TSR (4) Numerator]
AS [Measures].[RGU Upgrades]+
+[Measures].[Bulk XI RGU Connects]
+[Measures].[Bulk XTV RGU Connects]
+[Measures].[Bulk XV RGU Connects]
+[Measures].[Bulk XH RGU Connects],
FORMAT_STRING =  "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 0 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Agent TSR - RSR';

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Short Calls % Inbound 30 sec]
AS
    IIF([Measures].[Total Calls Handled Count]&lt;&gt;0 , ROUND(CoalesceEmpty([Measures].[THIRTY SECOND SHORT CALLS],0)/[Measures].[Total Calls Handled Count],4),NULL),
FORMAT_STRING = "Percent" ,VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Call Rates';    

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[After Call Work % of Handle Time]
AS
    IIF([Measures].[Total Agents Calls Handled Time]&lt;&gt;0 , ROUND(CoalesceEmpty([Measures].[Wrap Time],0)/[Measures].[Total Agents Calls Handled Time],4),NULL),
FORMAT_STRING = "Percent" ,VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Call Rates';     
 
CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Talk Time % of Handle Time]
AS
    IIF([Measures].[Total Agents Calls Handled Time]&lt;&gt;0 , ROUND(CoalesceEmpty(SUM(EXISTING[Interaction Attributes].[Interaction Medium].&amp;[Call],[Measures].[Interaction Talk Time]),0)/[Measures].[Total Agents Calls Handled Time],4),NULL),
FORMAT_STRING = "Percent" ,VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Call Rates';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Hold % of Handle Time]
AS
    IIF([Measures].[Total Agents Calls Handled Time]&lt;&gt;0 , ROUND(CoalesceEmpty([Measures].[Hold Time],0)/[Measures].[Total Agents Calls Handled Time],4),NULL),
FORMAT_STRING = "Percent" ,VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Call Rates';     

--2664

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Calls Transferred] AS 
IIF(ISERROR({[Call Only Attributes].[Type of Call].&amp;[Transfer],[Interaction Attributes].[Interaction Medium].&amp;[Call]}),
SUM(Existing({[Interaction Attributes].[Interaction Medium].&amp;[Call]},[MEASURES].[Total Interactions Handled])),0),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 , DISPLAY_FOLDER ='Call Rates';  

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Calls Transferred - Out] AS 
IIF(ISERROR({[Interaction Attributes].[Interaction Medium].&amp;[Call]}),
SUM(Existing({[Interaction Attributes].[Interaction Medium].&amp;[Call]},[MEASURES].[Interaction Transfers Out to Agent])) +
SUM(Existing({[Interaction Attributes].[Interaction Medium].&amp;[Call]},[MEASURES].[Interaction Transfers Out to Other])),
0),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 , DISPLAY_FOLDER ='Call Counts';  
---IIF(ISERROR({[Interaction Attributes].[Interaction Medium].&amp;[Call]}),Sum([Measures].[Interaction Transfers Out to Agent],[Measures].[Interaction Transfers Out to Other]),0),

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Calls Handled]
AS SUM(Existing({[Interaction Attributes].[Interaction Medium].&amp;[Call]},[MEASURES].[Total Interactions Handled])),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###.00;(#,###.00)",VISIBLE = 1 , DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Call Rates';

--Agent Chats

  

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Chats AHT]
AS
    IIF([Measures].[AGENT CHATS Count] &lt;&gt; 0 
    , ROUND(CoalesceEmpty([Measures].[CHAT DURATION],0)/[Measures].[AGENT CHATS Count],4)
    ,NULL
    )
,FORMAT_STRING = "#,##0.00;-#,##0.00",VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Agent Chats';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Chat SLA Met]  
AS 
    SUM([Agent Chat Characteristics].[SLA Met].&amp;[SLA Met],
    CoalesceEmpty([Measures].[AGENT CHATS Count],0))
    ,FORMAT_STRING = "#,##0;-#,##0", VISIBLE = 1, DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Agent Chats';       

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Chats per Productive Hr Closed]  
AS 
IIF([Measures].[Productive Time (Hrs)] &gt; 0, 
    SUM([Agent Chat Characteristics].[Status].&amp;[Closed],
    CoalesceEmpty([Measures].[AGENT CHATS Count],0)) / [Measures].[Productive Time (Hrs)]  ,
   Null),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,##0.00;-#,##0.00", VISIBLE = 0, DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Agent Chats';       

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Chats per Productive Hr Invalid]  
AS 
IIF([Measures].[Productive Time (Hrs)] &gt; 0, 
 SUM([Agent Chat Characteristics].[Status].&amp;[Invalid],
    CoalesceEmpty([Measures].[AGENT CHATS Count],0)) / [Measures].[Productive Time (Hrs)]  ,
   Null),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,##0.00;-#,##0.00", VISIBLE = 0, DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Agent Chats';       

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Chats per Productive Hr]  
AS [Measures].[Agent Chats per Productive Hr Closed]+[Measures].[Agent Chats per Productive Hr Invalid],
FORMAT_STRING = "#,##0.00;-#,##0.00", VISIBLE = 1, DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Agent Chats';       


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Chats Handle Time]
AS [Measures].[CHAT DURATION],
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)",  VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Agent Chats';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Agent Chat Average Speed Of Answer]
AS
    IIF([Measures].[AGENT CHATS Count] &lt;&gt; 0 
    , ROUND([Measures].[Agent Chats SPEED OF ANSWER]/[Measures].[AGENT CHATS Count],4)
    ,NULL
    )

---Sentiment and Quality Automation

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Sentiment]
AS DIVIDE(([Measures].[High Sentiment Count]-[Measures].[Low Sentiment Count]),([Measures].[Low Sentiment Count]+[Measures].[High Sentiment Count]+[Measures].[Neutral Sentiment Count]))*100,
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###.0;(#,###.0)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Sentiment and Quality Automation';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[High Sentiment Count]
AS (SUM(EXISTING[Sentiment and Quality Automation].[Sentiment Indicator].&amp;[1],[Measures].[Total Interactions Handled])),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Sentiment and Quality Automation';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Neutral Sentiment Count]

FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Sentiment and Quality Automation';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Low Sentiment Count]

FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Sentiment and Quality Automation';

---eNPS

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Response Rate] 
As IIF( ISERROR (strtomember('[eNPS].[Division Name].&amp;['+[Agent].[Agent Division].CurrentMember.Name+']')), NULL,
IIF( ISERROR (strtomember('[eNPS].[Agent Queue Name].&amp;['+[Agent].[Agent Queue].CurrentMember.Name+']')), NULL,
IIF( ISERROR (strtomember('[eNPS].[Agent Call Center Name].&amp;['+[Agent].[Agent Call Center].CurrentMember.Name+']')), NULL,
([Measures].[RESPONSERATE] , 
strtomember('[eNPS].[Division Name].&amp;['+[Agent].[Agent Division].CurrentMember.Name+']'),
strtomember('[eNPS].[Agent Queue Name].&amp;['+[Agent].[Agent Queue].CurrentMember.Name+']'),
strtomember('[eNPS].[Agent Call Center Name].&amp;['+[Agent].[Agent Call Center].CurrentMember.Name+']')
) ) ) ),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,##0.00;(#,##0.00)", VISIBLE = 0 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'eNPS';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Workplace] 
As IIF( ISERROR (strtomember('[eNPS].[Division Name].&amp;['+[Agent].[Agent Division].CurrentMember.Name+']')), NULL,
IIF( ISERROR (strtomember('[eNPS].[Agent Queue Name].&amp;['+[Agent].[Agent Queue].CurrentMember.Name+']')), NULL,

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Base Days Remaining]
 as DIVIDE(([Measures].[COUNT OF DAYS]-[Measures].[NO OF DAYS]),[Measures].[Number of Days])*-1
,FORMAT_STRING =  "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 0,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Sales Comp';    

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Number of Days Remaining]
 as case when [Fiscal Calendar].[Custom Period].CurrentMember.Level.Name = 'Custom Period' then [Measures].[Base Days Remaining] 
       when [Fiscal Calendar].[Fiscal Period].CurrentMember.Level.Name = 'Fiscal Period' then [Measures].[Base Days Remaining] 
       else null end
,FORMAT_STRING =  "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Sales Comp';

---Tickets
CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[All Tickets]
AS [Measures].[Audit_Trail_Count],
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Distinct Audit Trail Ticket Count]
AS [Measures].[Audit Trail Distinct Count],
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Tickets Resolved Count]
AS SUM(Existing([Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Resolved],[Measures].[Audit Trail Distinct Count])),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Tickets Resolved per Hour]
AS IIF([Measures].[Productive Time (Hrs)] &lt;&gt; 0 ,[Measures].[Tickets Resolved Count] / [Measures].[Productive Time (Hrs)],NULL),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###.00;(#,###.00)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Working Tickets]
AS SUM(Existing([Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Working],[Measures].[Audit Trail Distinct Count])),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Ticket Working Time]
AS [Measures].[WORKINGTIME],
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Ticket Average Working Time]
AS Divide([Measures].[Ticket Working Time],[Measures].[Audit Trail Distinct Count]),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###.00;(#,###.00)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Tickets Closed Count]
AS SUM(Existing([Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Closed],[Measures].[Audit Trail Distinct Count])),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Tickets Dispatched Count]
AS SUM(Existing([Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Dispatched],[Measures].[Audit Trail Distinct Count])),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Tickets Linked Count]
AS sum(Existing({[Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Assigned]
		,[Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Working]
		,[Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Parked]
		,[Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Linked]}
		,[MEASURES].[Audit Trail Distinct Count])),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Ticket Logs Count] 
as [Measures].[Tickets_Log_cnt]
,FORMAT_STRING =  "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 ,  DISPLAY_FOLDER = 'Tickets';    

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Touch Eligible] AS 
IIF(ISERROR({[Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Assigned],[Ticket Status].[Status Name].[ALL]}),ROUND(SUM([Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Assigned],[Measures].[Audit Trail Distinct Count]),4), NULL),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 , DISPLAY_FOLDER ='Tickets';        
--SUM(Existing([Ticket Status].[Status Name].&amp;[Assigned],[Measures].[Audit Trail Distinct Count])),

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Measures].[Touched] AS
IIF(ISERROR({[Audit Trail Characteristics].[Touch Description].&amp;[Touch],[Audit Trail Characteristics].[Touch Description.[ALL]}),ROUND(SUM([Audit Trail Characteristics].[Touch Description].&amp;[Touch],[Measures].[Touch Eligible]), 4), NULL),
FORMAT_STRING = "#,###;(#,###)", VISIBLE = 1 , DISPLAY_FOLDER ='Tickets';

SCOPE([Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[YOY Index]);     
THIS = DIVIDE([Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current],[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Year Ago]);     
END SCOPE;     

SCOPE([Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[YOY Diff]);     
THIS = [Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current] - [Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Year Ago];     
END SCOPE;     

CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Time Series].[Time Series].[Index Wtd]
AS iif(INTERSECT(Measures.CurrentMember,[Drop Measures]).Count&gt;0, -1, 1),
VISIBLE = 0;    


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS MM Index]
 AS (([Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Prior Period Index] - 1 ) *  [Time Series].[Time Series].[Index Wtd]) +1 ,
VISIBLE = 0;     


CREATE MEMBER CURRENTCUBE.[Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS YY Index]
 AS (([Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[YOY Index] - 1 ) *  [Time Series].[Time Series].[Index Wtd]) +1 ,
VISIBLE = 0;     


SCOPE([Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[M/M Index]);     
    THIS = [Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Prior Period Index];    
    SCOPE([Time Series Icon Attributes].[Marker Color].&amp;[Green]);     
       THIS = 
        iif(
            [Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS MM Index] &gt;= ([Measures].[Upper Threshold],[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current]),
            [Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Prior Period Index],
            null);     
   end Scope;     
    SCOPE([Time Series Icon Attributes].[Marker Color].&amp;[Red]);     
       THIS = 
        iif(
            [Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS MM Index] &lt; ([Measures].[Lower Threshold],[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current]),
            [Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Prior Period Index],
            null);     
   end Scope;     
   SCOPE([Time Series Icon Attributes].[Marker Color].&amp;[Yellow]);     
       THIS = 
        iif(
            [Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS MM Index] &gt;= ([Measures].[Lower Threshold],[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current]), 
            iif([Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS MM Index] &lt; ([Measures].[Upper Threshold],[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current]),
            [Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Prior Period Index],null),
            null);     
   end Scope;     
END SCOPE;     

SCOPE([Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Y/Y Index]);     
    THIS =[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[YOY Index];    
    SCOPE([Time Series Icon Attributes].[Marker Color].&amp;[Green]);     
       THIS = 
        iif(
            [Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS YY Index] &gt;= ([Measures].[Upper Threshold],[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current]),
            [Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[YOY Index],
            null);     
   end Scope;     
    SCOPE([Time Series Icon Attributes].[Marker Color].&amp;[Red]);     
       THIS = 
        iif(
            [Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS YY Index] &lt; ([Measures].[Lower Threshold],[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current]),
            [Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[YOY Index],
            null);     
   end Scope;     
   SCOPE([Time Series Icon Attributes].[Marker Color].&amp;[Yellow]);     
       THIS = 
        iif(
            [Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS YY Index] &gt;= ([Measures].[Lower Threshold],[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current]), 
            iif([Time Series].[Time Series].[ABS YY Index] &lt; ([Measures].[Upper Threshold],[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Current]),
            [Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[YOY Index],null),
            null);     
   end Scope;     
END SCOPE;     


scope([Parameters].[Comparison].&amp;[2]);    
[Time Series].[Time Series].&amp;[Prior Period]=null;
